Admittedly, one might argue that advertising brings undeniable economic benefits. This is creative content and appealing visual effects that stimulate consumer demand and therefore spending power and increasing production. Accordingly, people has more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation, leading to a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms, Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Besides, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, hence making it an important driver of economic activity.

However, some might argue that advertising has negative social consequences. It constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, or luxury possessions, consequently fostering dissatisfaction among viewers. For example, young people, in particular, feels pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook, leading to frustration when they cannot afford them, thereby advertising promotes materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, I strongly believe that both views are valid to some extent advertising which contributes to social dissatisfaction, or plays a crucial role in economic development.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that advertising brings important economic benefits, whereas others believe that it has negative social consequences. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. As demand rises, consumers spend more and production is encouraged. This creates more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation, contributing to a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms, say, Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam, rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers. Their campaigns boost both their sales and the entire digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates direct jobs in marketing, media, and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. Advertisements often present perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, and luxury possessions, fostering dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. When these products are beyond their budget, they can experience frustration. In the long run, this pressure can promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising supports employment, business growth, and state revenue, while it can also contribute to social dissatisfaction.

paragraphs: The widespread presence of news media has a major impact on people's daily lives and this is considered harmful to them. I believe that the frequent presence of news media has a major influence on people today, with both disadvantages and advantages for them.

Admittedly, news media have a substantial influence on people’s lives. The widespread access to smartphones and the Internet allows people to follow news instantly wherever and whenever they are; therefore, news will become a regular part of their routine. Additionally, the intense competition among news outlets means that, in order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, reinforcing the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, the development of news media has both positive and negative effects on people. When people are exposed to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news, they can become overwhelmed and feel overly anxious and helpless, even in situations that do not directly affect them. Nevertheless, news coverage warns the public to existing and looming problems in society, for instance, a crime, natural disasters, or political corruption; as a result, many individuals are better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats. This preparation helps them handle risks in an increasingly complex society.

In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that news media are present in many places where people can access them, which gives them a significant influence on people’s perspectives, and that their effects are not only negative.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that children are taught by their parents at home, they need not go to school. Although such development is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the advantages that it offers are far more pronounced.

Admittedly, schooling can bring some merits. It allows parents to save money as no school fees are required. At home, they educated children who are less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure and both factors can cause emotional and mental problems. Furthermore, when parents teaching their children at home by themselves, they must tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones; this is often not the case in traditional schooling because of the large class size.

However, I believe that the substantial detriments of this development far outweigh the positives. Initially, this educational approach might not actually save money as parents need to pay a large amount of money for lab equipment and tutors; therefore, one parent needs to be cut off to cater for their child's needs, be these academic or personal. Moreover, most parents are not well versed in all school subjects, this is difficulties in properly explaining concepts for and ultimately academic problems. Even social problems that children must be faced with at school as: bullying and having romantic feelings for others, thereby preparing them for social and workplace situations in the future.

In conclusion, although it is true that parents are choosing to schooling approach, while children must not practise at school may bring about a few advantages, these are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.
review.overall: Em có đủ bốn đoạn và đưa được ba lợi ích cùng ba bất lợi theo dàn ý. Nhưng mở bài nói 'advantages ... far more pronounced' trong khi Body 2 và kết bài kết luận ngược lại; đây là lỗi lập trường cần sửa trước tiên. Body 2 còn hai câu đứt cấu trúc ('this is difficulties', 'Even social problems ...') và kết bài ghép các mệnh đề không thành một câu trọn ý. paragraphs: There is an opinion that children should be taught by their parents at home instead of going to school. Although this approach is beneficial to a certain extent, I believe that the disadvantages it entails are far more pronounced.

Admittedly, supporters of homeschooling argue that this approach can bring some merits. Initially, it allows parents to save money, as no school fees are required. In addition, home-educated children are less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure, both of which can cause emotional and mental problems. Furthermore, when parents teach their children at home themselves, they can tailor their curriculum and pedagogical approaches to best suit their young ones; this is often not the case in traditional schools owing to the large class size.

However, I believe that the substantial detriments of this approach far outweigh its positives. Initially, it might not actually save money, as parents need to pay for lab equipment and tutors. One parent may also need to set aside working time to cater for the child's academic and personal needs. Moreover, most parents are not well versed in all school subjects, which can make it difficult to explain concepts to children properly and may lead to academic problems. Finally, even social problems that children face at school, such as bullying and having romantic feelings for others, can prepare them for social and workplace situations in the future.
In conclusion, although homeschooling may bring a few advantages, these are relatively minor and should not overshadow the far more significant and long-lasting drawbacks it entails.
